name: india-stack
description: Claude Code skills for building in India: UPI deep links, QR, status checks and AutoPay; GST tax split, invoices, e-invoicing and e-way bills; GSTIN/PAN/IFSC/Aadhaar validation and lakh/crore formatting; Aadhaar eKYC, Data Vault and DigiLocker; Account Aggregator consent flows; RBI card, localisation and refund rules; and the DPDP Act 2023 with DPDP Rules 2025.
